```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(survMisc)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(tidycmprsk)
```

#Data Set Up
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
data_path = "C:/Bre/SONOMA/Sonoma_cleaned.csv"

clean_s = read.csv(data_path, check.names = FALSE, row.names=1) 

#subsetting data to just NOM patients
NOM_patients <- clean_s[clean_s$initial_planoutcomes == 2,] 

NOM_patients <- NOM_patients[!is.na(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes),] #removing NA values for date/time of patients dx of appendicitis
#sum(is.na(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes)) #looking for NAs
NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes <- gsub(" .*","", NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes) #removing time part of date/time
#sum(is.na(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes)) #checking for NAs again

#converting date_index to date object


NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes <- ymd(NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes)


#converting date of appendectomy after NOM to date object, converting blanks to NAs
NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes[
  NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes == ""
] <- NA

NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes <- ymd(NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes)


#creating variable that is time in days from NOM decision to appy
NOM_patients$time_to_appy <- NOM_patients$appy_int_dateoutcomes - NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes
#I thought they were only followed for a year after, but many of these times look way past 365 days so what time for censored individuals?

#DONT NEED THIS IF WE GET NEW TIMES FOR TWO ERRORS
NOM_patients <- NOM_patients[NOM_patients$time_to_appy > 0 | is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_appy), ] #DONT NEED THIS IF WE GET NEW TIMES


#setting NA values to 0 for censored, creating status variable for survival
NOM_patients$status <- ifelse(
  is.na(NOM_patients$interval_typeoutcomes),
  0,   # censored
  NOM_patients$interval_typeoutcomes
)



NOM_patients$status <- as.numeric(NOM_patients$status)



#creating time_to_event for all NOM patients, making it 365 for censored individuals
NOM_patients$time_to_event <- ifelse(
  is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_appy),
  365,
  NOM_patients$time_to_appy
)
#administratively censoring those beyond 1 year
NOM_patients$status365 <- ifelse(
  NOM_patients$time_to_event > 365, 
  0, #administratively censored beyond 1 year
  NOM_patients$status
)

#changing time to event to 365 days for censored beyond 1 year individuals
NOM_patients$time_to_event <- ifelse(
  NOM_patients$status365 == 0, 
  365, 
  NOM_patients$time_to_event
)

NOM_patients$status <- factor(NOM_patients$status, 0:2, c("None", "Elective", "Urgent/Emergent"))

NOM_patients$any_appy <- ifelse(NOM_patients$status365 != 0, 1, 0)

```

## Aalen Johansen Estimator of competing risk of urgent vs elective appendectomy
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

library(mstate)
NOM_patients$event <- factor(NOM_patients$status365, 0:2, c("Censored", "Elective", "Urgent/Emergent"))
fit <- survfit(Surv(time_to_event, event) ~1, data = NOM_patients)
#fit$transitions

par(mar = c(5, 4, 5, 8), xpd = NA)

plot(
  fit,
  xmax = 1200,
  ymax = 800,
  col = 1:2,
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Days since NOM",
  ylab = "Probability", 
  main = "Probability of Appendectomy by 1 Year Post-NOM"
)

legend(
  "right",
  inset = c(-0.31, 0),
  legend = c("Elective", "Emergent"),
  lty = 1,
  lwd = 2,
  col = 1:2,
  bty = "n"
)

#add line for All appendectomy
# Extract summary
s <- summary(fit)


time_vals <- s$time

# Extract each transition probability
elective_ci <- s$pstate[, "Elective"]
urgent_ci   <- s$pstate[, "Urgent/Emergent"]

# Compute total appendectomy
all_ci <- elective_ci + urgent_ci


par(mar = c(5, 4, 5, 8), xpd = NA)


plot(
  fit,
  fun = "event",
  xlim = c(0, 365),
  ylim = c(0, 0.5),
  col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728"),
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 1,
  xlab = "Days After Index Treatment with Antibiotics",
  ylab = "Cumulative Incidence of Appendectomy",
  main = "Risk of Appendectomy After NOTA",
  mark.time = FALSE,
  conf.int = FALSE
)

# Add total appendectomy curve
lines(
  time_vals,
  all_ci,
  col = "black",
  lwd = 3,
  lty = 2
)


legend(
  "right",
  inset = c(-0.31, 0),
  legend = c("Elective", "Urgent", "All"),
  col = c("#1f77b4", "#d62728", "black"),
  lwd = 2,
  lty = c(1, 1, 1),
  bty = "n",
)

overall_surv_fit <- survfit(Surv(time_to_event, any_appy) ~ 1, data = NOM_patients)

overall_data <- data.frame(
  time = overall_surv_fit$time,
  overall_incidence = 1 - overall_surv_fit$surv, 
  lower = 1 - overall_surv_fit$upper, 
  upper = 1 - overall_surv_fit$lower, 
  outcome = "Any"
)
comprisk <- ci_fit %>%
  ggcuminc(outcome = c("Elective", "Urgent/Emergent")) +
    add_confidence_interval(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.6) +
  aes(color = outcome, fill = outcome) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Elective"  = "#1f77b4", "Urgent/Emergent" = "#d62728", "Any" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Elective"  = "#1f77b4", "Urgent/Emergent" = "#d62728", "Any" = "black")) +
  theme_classic() + # Professional theme
  labs(
    x = "Days post-transplant",
    y = "Cumulative Incidence of Relapse"
  ) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) # Clean, readable text

comprisk


comprisk + geom_ribbon( data = overall_data, aes(x = time, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = outcome), alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE ) + geom_step( data = overall_data, aes(x = time, y = overall_incidence, color = outcome), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE )



```

## Setting up data for Kaplan Meier time to appendicitis symptoms
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

NOM_patients$ed_ret_dateoutcomes[
  NOM_patients$ed_ret_dateoutcomes == ""
] <- NA

NOM_patients$ed_ret_dateoutcomes <- as.Date(
  NOM_patients$ed_ret_dateoutcomes,
  format = "%m/%d/%Y"
)

#creating variable that is time in days from NOM decision to appy
NOM_patients$time_to_EDsymptoms <- NOM_patients$ed_ret_dateoutcomes - NOM_patients$time_of_dxoutcomes


NOM_patients$time_to_ED <- ifelse(
  is.na(NOM_patients$time_to_EDsymptoms),
  365,
  NOM_patients$time_to_EDsymptoms
)
#administratively censoring those beyond 1 year
NOM_patients$ED_status <- ifelse(
  NOM_patients$time_to_ED > 365, 
  0, #administratively censored beyond 1 year
  NOM_patients$ed_return_365outcomes
)

#if reason for ED visit is 1 (cont. or worsening physical symptoms) or 2 (recurrence of symptoms) then it still equals 1, else 0
NOM_patients$ED_status <- ifelse(
  NOM_patients$ED_status == 1 & (NOM_patients$ed_reasonoutcomes == 1 | NOM_patients$ed_reasonoutcomes == 2),
  1, 
  0)

table(NOM_patients$ED_status)


#Should we show percentage of those who came back w/ symptoms but didn't get appendectomy?
```

#Kaplan Meier Plot of Time to Appendicitis symptoms
```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time_to_ED, ED_status) ~ 1, data = NOM_patients, conf.type = "log-log")

ggsurvplot(km_fit, data = NOM_patients, conf.int = T, ggtheme = theme_survminer(),
           title = "Likelihood of Avoiding Emergency Care 1 Year Post-NOM", xlab = "Days since NOM", ylab = "Overall Probability", palette = "blue")

na_fit <- survfit(Surv(time_to_ED, ED_status) ~ 1, data = NOM_patients, conf.type = "log-log") 
ggsurvplot(na_fit, fun = "cumhaz",  title = "Cumulative Hazard Function 1 Year Post-NOM", xlab = "Days since NOM", ylab = "Cumulative Hazard Rate",)

```
